newsitem.title: USA: Kubo - Japan, U.S. welcome current forex movements.
newsitem.headline: Kubo - Japan, U.S. welcome current forex movements.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Wataru Kubo said Saturday he agreed with U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin that they welcomed current currency movements.

"We agreed that we welcome the direction of the currency movements as we have said during the Lyons (G7) summit (in June)," Kubo told reporters after brief discussions with Rubin ahead of a meeting of G7 central bankers and finance ministers.
Asked whether Rubin had urged Japan to take further steps to stimulate its economy, Kubo said "Not that I can remember. We did not discuss in detail about economic stimulus steps."
They also did not talk about monetary policy, he added.
Kubo said he explained to Rubin about Japan's current economic conditions and its need for fiscal consolidation.
Kubo said he also agreed with Rubin that Japan and U.S. will make efforts for early settlement over a long-running dispute on access to Japan's insurance market.
